references.text: God declares, "I will take you to be my people and I will be your God" - the same formula where the Lord identifies himself as Israel's God
The introduction to the Ten Commandments with the same self-presentation: "I am the Lord your God"
The same divine self-identification, "I am the Lord your God," as the basis for the commandment of holiness
A parallel introduction where Moses is to speak to the children of Israel, with the justification, "I am the Lord your God"
Repetition of the formula, "I am the Lord your God," as authority for the commands
The requirement of holiness grounded in, "I am the Lord your God"
Ezekiel uses the same covenant formula where God says, "I am the Lord your God"
God reminds Israel of the covenant relationship with the words, "I am the Lord your God"
